title: AUTOMATION, MARKET SNIPER, AUTO LIST, ETC KEYLESS
features:
**Update Log - 10/4 10:03PM UTC**

New
Auto Train (Crew tab) - trains your henchmen automatically, can pull from bank
Steal Mode (Market > Sniper) - snipes mythic+ items listed way under value, no setup needed
Respect Hunter (Fight > Targets) - goes for the highest respect wins you can safely take
XP / Hour option for Auto Operations
Family Only option for Heist Favors
Menu Blur toggle in Settings > Performance (off by default)

Changes
Auto Roll: "Stop At Rarity" is now a "Keep Rarities" dropdown where you can select multiple rarities to keep (ex. Mythic + Secret). Re-pick yours and re-save your config
Multi-select dropdowns show your picks properly now instead of cutting off, and ticked options get a checkmark

Fixes
Fixed added safe check Auto Roll sometimes dismissing a kept henchman if you moved crew around while it was rolling
Auto Equip pauses while Auto Roll is running
Fixed possibly some lag with Auto Fight on
Fixed a freeze when the Never Sell list refreshed
General performance improvements, faster startup
